name: selection-highlight
opens_with: (agent script seeds a message, then simulated down+drag selects it)
notes: The boot screen has no selectable transcript (the offline placeholder is not the message area), so assistant-simple.json seeds one assistant message first; the drag then anchors (col 5, row 25) and extends to (col 30) across it — apply_selection_highlight paints the range with the 58% accent bg blend (SELECTION_BLEND=0.58, selection.rs:56) and 32% white fg blend (SELECTION_FG_BLEND=0.32, selection.rs:59). The style golden is the blend guard: any change to either constant shifts every painted cell's bg/fg and fails verify. Deliberately no <release> token — the Up handler takes the auto-copy branch when anchor != focus and a headless clipboard write could block; that path is outside this surface.
